Comment “APPLY” for full details to your inbox 🚀

We’re recruiting a Junior Technician for the 2026 World Sportbike Championship.

This is a hands on trackside role in a professional race team, working in a fast paced, high pressure environment in the @worldsbk paddock.

Paid role
Accommodation and food provided
Opportunity to progress

Fairly busy last week to say the least! With a drive down all the way through France and Spain, a couple days riding in Barcelona and Alicante on my @phrperformance prepped Triumph Daytona 660, then the surgery to remove my plate and screws from my ankle. 
-
All went super well, although it’s a tricky period having to rest and recover, it’s definitely the best decision moving forward into 2026 💪🏻. 
- 
Will be back up and running soon in the new year, which I look forward too 😎. In the meantime, I would like to wish everyone a merry Christmas, and a happy new year 😁🔥

Great day back training today @circuitoyepesmotor ! Spinning laps on the CBR500 and a pitbike really helped get some good feeling back on 2 wheels, plus seeing the condition of my foot since my accident. 
-
All good things to report with no pain or discomfort, just an extra edge to get back out on a bike again soon 🤪. -
A big shoutout to @arcon_gloves for the best glove protection in the game. I feel confident rolling out of pitlane knowing my hands are in the best form of protection 🙌🏻. The most comfortable glove on the market from brand new, great flexibility when riding adds to that extra feel of throttle and brake whilst on the bike 💪🏻. 
-
